about: OneGrasp Stress & Resilience Check for working professionals (0-5, 5-15, 15+ years). Burnout uses the Copenhagen Burnout Inventory (Kristensen et al., 2005), personal and work-related scales, word for word. Coping uses eight scales of the Brief COPE (Carver, 1997), word for word, with the time frame set to the last 4 weeks as the author allows. Every other section is OneGrasp's own wording in the same standard format (4-week recall, 5-point scales scored 0-100). Item ids are stable - results store answers by id, so never reuse an id for a different question.

items.text: I had more work than I could finish in my working hours.
